problem: The requirement applies the approved suitability status to every heading-reference and position-fixing system, but the candidate constrains only one ship-level approval-status value and does not associate each system with its intended area or approval status.
required_change: Represent the systems as qualified resources or otherwise establish a per-system relationship, and require each system's intended-area suitability approval status to have exactly the approved value.
regression_guard: Preserve the ship target and the approved controlled value while ensuring the constraint is evaluated for every applicable system.
